Bars: median of six fresh processes (two interleaved groups of three on one host and CPU); whiskers: min–max of all six, not confidence intervals.
Generic: ten member reads per document; TruffleData heap includes 240 B of read views and excludes native input and index memory. Number-heavy: canada-style coordinates. Typed: three-field
records through a compiled JsonPlan versus a hand-written Gson streaming decoder.
One quiet host (AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9965WX 24-Cores), every shard in sequence on one pinned CPU · Linux x86-64 · GraalVM Native Image · O2 · serial GC · no PGO.
